Stage.LogText: {=da_log_0}Your clan's deeds echo across the taverns and keeps of Calradia. The renowned master smith {EfsaneviDemirci_Link}, located in {DemirciSehri_Link}, has sent word, seeking you out to reforge an ancient blade bound to your bloodline.

{=da_log_1}Ride to the village of {HammadeKaynagi_Link} and speak with {KoyMuhtari_Link} to procure 5 Star Iron ore. Beware: rumors suggest cutthroats hired by {RakipTuccar_Link} are already circling the quarry.
{=da_log_2}The rival merchant's hired mercenaries are nearby carrying the stolen Star Iron! Defeat them in battle to reclaim the ore.
{=da_log_kestirme}You bypassed the ore gathering by purchasing the master's ready-forged sword for a steep sum of 10,000 denars.
{=da_log_3}You hold 5 Star Iron in your packs. Deliver them to {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} so the forging of the Covenant Sword can begin.
{=da_log_1_success}You delivered the 5 Star Iron ore to {EfsaneviDemirci_Link}. With ancient craft and roaring coals, the master forged your bloodline's Covenant Sword!

DialogNode.Text: {=da_giris_p}You sent word for me, master smith?

{=da_c1_intro_npc}Welcome, warrior. Hear you the deep breath of the bellows? For generations, this hearth has burned in kinship with your bloodline. I knew your forebears well; these hands shaped the ancient steel that laid your house's seat. Yet centuries have passed, and banners have fallen. It is time you carried a Covenant Sword worthy of your lineage.
{=da_c1_p_soru_zanaat}Teach me too the secret of folding this steel, master. Whence springs this ancient bond between your forge and my bloodline?
{=da_c1_p_lore_savas}I care not for ancient tales, but for steel that splits shields in twain. What would you ask of me, smith?
{=da_c1_p_soru_tuccar}Such a weapon commands immense weight in both war and trade. What does your guild seek from our clan in exchange?
{=da_cirak_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_c1_npc_lore_zanaat}Your spirit honors your ancestors, child! Before the First Empire arose, a blazing star fell from the firmament into these hills. The ancient guild and your bloodline swore a blood covenant to guard its heart. The Covenant Sword cannot be folded from earthly ores; I require 5 chunks of genuine fallen Star Iron.

{=da_c1_npc_lore_savas}Any horse-shoer can hammer out shield-splitting iron, child! The blade I speak of reaps the destiny of kingdoms. You yearn to spill blood, I know, yet without the forge's spirit, the steel you swing is no better than a timber club. Only one ore can birth such a weapon: 5 chunks of genuine fallen Star Iron!

{=da_c1_npc_lore_tuccar}Coin buys hirelings, but only sacred steel purchases eternity. Our guild seeks no denars from you, but fidelity to our oath. If our steel sleeps in an unworthy scabbard, our guild's purpose turns to ash. That is why you must bring 5 chunks of Star Iron to this anvil.
{=da_c1_p_sorgu_maden}Star Iron... What secret lies within this ore? What makes it so unyielding upon your anvil?
{=da_c1_p_sorgu_dusman}Where lies this ore vein, and who dares stand in our path? Whoever bars my way shall taste my steel.
{=da_cirak_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_c1_npc_detay_maden}Star Iron shimmers with a pale celestial sheen in darkness; though it blazes white-hot in the hearth, it remains cold and stubborn beneath the hammer. The only bellows in Calradia capable of yielding it are here. A vein was uncovered in the quarry near {HammadeKaynagi_Link}. But the miners cannot haul it unaided; a covetous merchant, {RakipTuccar_Link}, caught scent of it and encircled the quarry with spies.

{=da_c1_npc_detay_dusman}The ore lies in the quarry of {HammadeKaynagi_Link}. Yet the true hazard is not the rock, but the hired cutthroats of merchant {RakipTuccar_Link}! That greedy vulture seeks to seize my craft and sell the celestial ore to imperial palaces for a king's ransom. You must confer with the village elder {KoyMuhtari_Link} and secure the ore.
{=da_c1_p_durus_cirak}Your hearth shall never turn cold, master. I will ride to the village, confer with the elder, and carry the Star Iron to your anvil myself.
{=da_c1_p_durus_savasci}If that merchant's hired dogs dare cross my path, I shall leave their carcasses for the crows. I ride for the village at once.
{=da_c1_p_durus_pratik}Time is dearer than gold, master. If you have an existing prototype ready upon your rack, can I not purchase it here and now?
{=da_cirak_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_c1_npc_tartma_cirak}In your eyes I see the sacred devotion of the ancient apprentices. Go then: speak with elder {KoyMuhtari_Link} in {HammadeKaynagi_Link}, secure the 5 Star Iron chunks, and let our brotherhood begin.

{=da_c1_npc_tartma_savasci}Fierce fire burns in your veins, warlord! But temper your wrath with vigilance. Ride to {HammadeKaynagi_Link}, wrench the 5 Star Iron from the clutches of {RakipTuccar_Link}'s dogs, and bring them back!

{=da_c1_npc_tartma_pratik}You speak with the cold calculation of a merchant, child. Aye, upon my rack rests a prototype forged from an earlier sample. But it is my masterpiece; I will not part with it for less than 10,000 denars. The choice is yours: ride for the ore, or pay the coin.
{=da_c1_karar_kabul}My oath is sealed, master. I ride for {HammadeKaynagi_Link} to secure the Star Iron.
{=da_tek_p2}Master, don't misunderstand... War waits for no smith. Is that finished blade upon your rack for sale? Can I purchase it here and now for 10,000 gold?
{=da_cirak_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_c1_npc_ugurla}May the spirits of our forebears guide your stride, child. Ride to {HammadeKaynagi_Link} and find {KoyMuhtari_Link}. Keep your eyes sharp and your blade loose in its scabbard. I shall kindle the coals against your return.

{=da_tek_npc_kestirme}You lack the patience of a true swordsman, child. Yet if coin is how you wage war, so be it. Take the blade; it carries the blood of my forge, even if bought rather than earned. We shall see if you are worthy of what comes next...
{=da_muhtar_p_giris}I am here on behalf of {EfsaneviDemirci_Link}. I have come to collect the Star Iron ore from your quarry.

{=da_muhtar_dlg_1}Gods deliver us! You arrive in the shadow of disaster, warrior! We mined five hefty chunks of Star Iron, but just an hour ago, bloodthirsty sellswords bearing the mark of {RakipTuccar_Link} raided our cart just beyond the village ditch! They seized all the ore and are lurking outside our borders, waiting to slay anyone who pursues them!
{=da_c1_m_p_sorgu_pusu}How many were they, and which direction did they flee? Did they spill village blood?
{=da_c1_m_p_sorgu_tarih}How long has this quarry been worked, elder? Who else knew of this shipment?
{=da_cirak_muhtar_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_c1_m_npc_lore_pusu}Thirty armored cutthroats at least! They ambushed our wagon in the gully just past the ditch, loaded the ore into their saddlebags, and now lurk in the brush mocking us. If you approach, they will bare their blades!

{=da_c1_m_npc_lore_tarih}The quarry is ancient, but this celestial vein was uncovered only weeks ago. The merchant's spies bribed one of our mule drivers! Our foreman stashed five ingots in the furnace vault, but the main haul was taken.
{=da_c1_m_p_sorgu_mevki}Describe their ambush position and defensive lines, elder; I will strike them like a thunderbolt.
{=da_c1_m_p_sorgu_mahzen}Kept you no reserve ore in the quarry cellars? Is there no emergency cache in the village?
{=da_cirak_muhtar_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_c1_m_npc_detay_mevki}They pitched camp among the crags northwest of the ditch. They watch the highway, but approaching through the gully lets you take their flank by surprise.
{=da_c1_m_npc_detay_mahzen}Our foreman locked five rough ingots deep in the furnace cellar as our village famine reserve. For two thousand denars to feed our miners' families, I will turn the key.
{=da_muhtar_p_savas}They picked the wrong quarry to plunder. I will hunt down these dogs and take back our Star Iron in blood.
{=da_muhtar_p_satinal}Do you have any reserve ore kept in your cellars? I will pay 2,000 gold right now to compensate your miners.
{=da_cirak_muhtar_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_muhtar_dlg_savas}May the heavens strengthen your arm! They cannot have gone far, so ride out and strike before they escape with our ore!

{=da_muhtar_dlg_satinal}Aye, our foreman held five rough ingots in the locked furnace store for emergencies. For two thousand gold, our village can rebuild. Here, take the ore to the smith before more cutthroats smell it!
{=da_katiller_dlg_intro}That star iron belongs to our master! Turn back, lordling, or your blood will quench the ore!
{=da_katiller_p_savas}My steel will speak for me. Draw!
{=da_muhtar_tesekkur_p_giris}Elder, the hired cutthroats have been dealt with and the Star Iron is safe in my packs.

{=da_muhtar_tesekkur_npc_1}Bless your blade, warrior! Since you broke the backs of {RakipTuccar_Link}'s cutthroats, our miners can finally breathe easy and work the quarry in peace. You have done this village a great service.
{=da_muhtar_tesekkur_p_devam}Your quarry is safe now, elder. I shall take my leave soon.
{=da_muhtar_tesekkur_mahzen_p_giris}Elder, the Star Iron from your cellar reserve is secure in my packs.

{=da_muhtar_tesekkur_mahzen_npc_1}Bless your generosity, warrior! With the two thousand gold you paid for our reserve ingots, our miners' families will weather the winter and rebuild what {RakipTuccar_Link}'s raiders ruined. You have done this village a great service.
{=da_muhtar_tesekkur_mahzen_p_devam}May your village recover swiftly, elder. I shall take my leave soon.

{=da_muhtar_tesekkur_npc_2}Keep your horses swift and carry those Star Iron chunks straight back to master smith {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} in {DemirciSehri_Link}! His hearth is already roaring for your return. May the heavens guard your road, friend.
{=da_teslim_p_giris}Master smith, I hold the five chunks of Star Iron you commanded me to fetch.
{=da_teslim_ready}By the anvil of the ancients! That dark, starlit sheen... It is genuine fallen star-metal! You survived the merchant's cutthroats and claimed what is rightfully yours.
{=da_c1_teslim_p_hurmet}Your hearth's fire and our ancestors' oath guided my path, master. The hands worthy of forging this celestial steel are yours alone.
{=da_c1_teslim_p_savas}Those who barred my way tasted cold wrath. Enough words; let us hear the anvil ring beneath your hammer!
{=da_c1_teslim_p_pratik}It was a grueling trial, but our covenant held firm, master. The renown this steel brings shall reward us both.
{=da_c1_teslim_npc_hurmet}A true apprentice of the covenant! Now watch closely: Star Iron requires celestial flux to bond with the iron core. A single mistimed hammer blow can shatter weeks of labor.
{=da_c1_teslim_npc_savas}The anvil echoes your war-cry, warrior! Yet know this: raw anger shatters brittle steel. Only when wrath is cooled in disciplined water does the edge become eternal.
{=da_c1_teslim_npc_pratik}Every drop of sweat poured upon this hearth will echo across the realm, warlord. No merchant in Calradia can match what we shape today.
{=da_c1_teslim_p_basla}Stoke the flames, master! Let the anvil ring and let the Covenant Sword be born!
{=da_c1_teslim_npc_bitis}Kindle the bellows! Your apprentice's oath has been honored in blood and toil, child. Now let the hearth roar, and let the steel take shape!
